Title: HistoryInclusionMode - Chat History Inclusion Control
Summary: Enum controlling how much chat history is included when sending messages to the AI. Supports full history, limited iterations, or instruct mode.
Content:
## HistoryInclusionMode

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Controls how chat history is sent to the AI. Determines which historical messages are included in the context window for each iteration.

### Enum Definition
```csharp
[JsonConverter(typeof(JsonStringEnumConverter))]
public enum HistoryInclusionMode
{
    All,
    LastTwo,
    LastTen,
    Instruct
}
```

### Values
| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `All` | Includes the entire conversation history |
| `LastTwo` | Includes only the last 2 iterations (user + assistant pairs) |
| `LastTen` | Includes only the last 10 iterations |
| `Instruct` | Includes no history — each message is treated as a standalone instruction |

### Usage
```csharp
// Set on chat configuration
var config = new ChatConfiguration();
config.HistoryInclusion = HistoryInclusionMode.LastTwo;

// Default value
config.HistoryInclusion = HistoryInclusionMode.All; // Default
```

### Related
- `ChatConfiguration` - Stores the HistoryInclusion setting
- `IConversationHistoryTransformer` - May use this mode to filter history
- `IChatMessageService` - Applies history inclusion when building kernel history
